item.title: Oscars 2026 Winner Predictions: See Our Picks for Every Category
item.description: A lot is still uncertain, which is unusual for this stage in the game—but here’s who we think will come out on top in best picture, best actor, and every other Oscar category. (Including the shorts!)

item.title: An Oral History of the Vanity Fair Oscar Party
item.description: From the humble(ish) beginning at Mortons to this year’s revamped blowout, here’s the full story of Hollywood’s biggest night—as told by Gwyneth Paltrow, Anjelica Huston, Tom Ford, Fran Lebowitz, Graydon Carter, and more.

item.title: Kate Middleton Fulfills an Important Duty as Princess of Wales for the First Time
item.description: The future queen has checked off another royal first by delivering a short message in Welsh. Did she join Prince William in enlisting the help of the Duolingo owl?

item.title: Julia Fox’s Fashion at the Vanity Fair Oscar Party Through the Years
item.description: The Uncut Gems star has never made an uninteresting choice for the bash.

item.title: Royal Photographer Chris Jackson “Noticed a Significant Change In the Way Things Are Done” With King Charles Reign
item.description: The Getty Images photog talks to Vanity Fair about his new book, Modern Majesty: The British Royal Family Today and why he feels “we have entered a new era for the British royal family.”

item.title: The Best Oscar Dresses of All Time: A History of Fashion at the Academy Awards
item.description: The Academy Awards showcase film—and fashion. See some of the most thrilling looks of all time, including the best Oscar dresses.

item.title: With That Action-Packed Finale, Bridgerton Enters a Bold New Era, Says Showrunner Jess Brownell
item.description: “These are stories that are very much going to shake up the formula that we’ve seen from the first four seasons of Bridgerton,” Brownell recently told Vanity Fair.

item.title: Yerin Ha on Her First Awards Show, That Bridgerton Bathtub Scene, and Dressing “Out of Your Comfort Zone”
item.description: “The unknown used to really scare the living daylights out of me,” Ha tells Vanity Fair while getting ready for the Actor Awards 2026. “But with Bridgerton, I learned so much can change within a short period of time.”

item.title: All About the Baptismal Robe That Queen Elizabeth II (and 62 More Royal Children) Have Worn
item.description: Starting April 10, more than 200 items from Elizabeth II's wardrobe will be on display at the King's Gallery at Buckingham Palace. A highlight is a 185-year-old item made by Queen Victoria and passed down from child to child in the royal family.

item.title: At a DC Defense-Tech Conference, No Hegseth—and “Epic Fury”
item.description: Vanity Fair tech correspondent Julia Black goes inside Andreessen Horowitz’s American Dynamism Summit in the first edition of her new column, “A Billion to One.”
